evidence.P1: Within each plot the events chain by condition (Neo plot: ev-007 refusal → ev-008 mouthless rescue; Crew plot: ev-025 sacrifice → ev-026 capture → ev-029 betrayal → ev-031 interrogation), but the Neo chain skips ev-011/ev-012 (rebirth/rebuild) between ev-010 and ev-013, and the Society chain jumps ev-020 → ev-045, leaving the death/revival mechanism asserted rather than caused within the plot.
evidence.P2: Every plot holds one stance: the Neo plot reads each event as 'claimed vs embodied identity' (ev-015 'I know kung fu' falsified by the spar), the Morpheus plot as 'faith vs proof' (ev-020 body-count counter-argument), the Society plot as 'truth vs comfortable lie' (ev-020 steak/bargain), never drifting into retelling.
evidence.P3: Most cited events earn their place, but the Neo plot omits ev-011 (pod birth) and ev-012 (rebuild) that the summary's 'recoils as the Construct reveals' depends on, and the Society plot omits ev-044 (the kiss/revival) that ev-045's code-vision causally requires, so membership is incomplete at two load-bearing joints.
evidence.P4: Setups, turns and resolutions are present across spans (Neo: ev-004 doubt → ev-039 refusal of Smith's name → ev-045 acting as the One; Society: ev-005 comfortable lie → ev-013 desert of the real → ev-047 flight), though the Neo arc's middle is thinned by the ev-011/ev-012 gap and the Society arc compresses the entire third act into ev-045.
evidence.P5: ev-045 (Neo stops bullets/destroys Smith) is the resolution event in four of the five plots and ev-047 closes three of them, while ev-020, ev-032 and ev-016 recur across plots with near-identical framing, so the Society, Crew and Neo plots substantially rehash the same turning points rather than partitioning distinct event sets.

raw.commentary: The layer is disciplined in stance (P2) and mostly sound in intra-plot causality (P1), but it is weakened by two structural faults. First, membership gaps (P3): the Neo and Society chains drop load-bearing events (ev-011/ev-012; ev-044) that their own summaries invoke, so the chains do not fully carry the claims made about them. Second and more serious is redundancy (P5): the five plots converge on the same climax (ev-045) and share ev-016/ev-020/ev-032, meaning the Society and Crew plots in particular are not extracting a distinct event subset but re-describing the Neo/Morpheus material under a different theme. Tightening would mean (a) restoring the omitted events where a summary leans on them, and (b) reassigning shared events so each plot owns a non-overlapping resolution rather than all terminating at ev-045.
